name: tix
description: Work tix tasks from Mattermost: create, move, close and comment, live task cards, channel feeds and personal notifications.

settings.help_text: The root of the tix server, for example https://tix.example.com.

A tix token holding token:admin, user:admin, tenant:admin and webhook:admin, plus every scope it hands out to people (task:read, task:write, task:transition, task:claim, project:read, workflow:read, comment:write, artifact:write, event:subscribe, audit:read), since tix only lets a token grant scopes it holds. An admin role token (*) works. With it, `/tix connect` issues each person a tix token of their own, matched by their verified email, and `/tix webhook setup` registers the plugin's webhook. Without it, people paste a token they made in tix.
Encrypts the tix tokens the plugin stores. Regenerating it disconnects everyone.
settings.regenerate_help_text: Everyone has to run /tix connect again.

settings.help_text: tix signs the webhooks it sends the plugin with this secret.
Turn task references such as infra-42 in messages into live task cards.

Reply: the tix bot answers a message with its cards in the thread, and the message stays as written. Inline: the cards are attached to the message itself, which then shows as edited when a card is redrawn.
A task that got a card in a channel gets no further card there for this many minutes. 0 means the default of 10.
Reacting to a message with this emoji creates a tix task from it in the channel's default project (set with /tix channel project). The emoji name without colons; leave empty for ticket.

How much a channel feed post says about its task. Compact: one line, who did what. Detailed: adds the assignee, priority and due date. Card: each event as a small card. `/tix subscribe --detail` overrides it per feed.

settings.display_name: Comment text in feeds and DMs:
settings.help_text: Full: the whole comment, quoted. Excerpt: its first 200 characters on one line, cut at a word. None: only says that someone commented. `/tix subscribe --comments` overrides it per feed.
Names: feed posts name people without notifying them. Mentions: feed posts @-mention connected people, which notifies them. `/tix subscribe --people` overrides it per feed.

The fields task cards show, in this order, separated by commas: status, assignee, priority, due, tags, project (the project goes in the card's footer). Leave empty for all of them. Unknown names are ignored and logged.
settings.placeholder: status, assignee, priority, due, tags, project
settings.default: status, assignee, priority, due, tags, project

settings.help_text: How many buttons for moving the task to its next states a card shows, the sensible moves first.

settings.display_name: Show the Assign to me button:
settings.help_text: Cards of open tasks get an Assign to me button.
Cards get a Comment button that opens a comment dialog.

How dates are written in cards, task commands, the digest and feeds. EU: 17.11.2026. ISO: 2026-11-17. Relative: today, in 2 days, 3 days ago, with the date beyond two weeks. A date without a time of day is the same day in every time zone; other dates follow each reader's Mattermost time zone.

The sections of the daily digest, in this order, separated by commas: overdue, due_today, new, blocked, in_progress, counts. A task shows in the first of its sections that is listed. Leave empty for all of them. Unknown names are ignored and logged.
settings.placeholder: overdue, due_today, new, blocked, in_progress, counts
settings.default: overdue, due_today, new, blocked, in_progress, counts

settings.help_text: The name the tix bot shows with its posts. Its username stays tix.

An https URL of a PNG, at most 1 MiB and 1024x1024 pixels, to use as the bot's icon. It is fetched once when the setting changes; addresses on private networks are refused. Leave empty for the tix icon.
